verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Authorization Rules v2 support MCC-based allow/block logic ('rules based on high-signal attributes like MCC') applied at program, account, or card level (card-level = single-merchant/single-card lock), enforced at authorization time via the ASA/auth stream. The blog post also demonstrates configuring merchant-category rules and testing them against live authorization transactions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a true 'single-merchant lock' feature (as opposed to card-level MCC rules) and independent third-party confirmation of MCC allow/blocklist behavior in production.
